description: Ships Governed SDD's Proceed authority and closure procedure while retaining independent review as a mandatory gate.
delta: Proceed authorizes the complete gated closure through one integration push and cleanup, while excluding release, tag, destructive push, history-rewrite, forced-cleanup, review-bypass, conflict-resolution, and unrelated-task actions. Governed Review: REQUIRED stops at REVIEW_REQUIRED as a gate, not an authorization request; after approval the reviewer-integrator performs integration. Review: NOT_REQUIRED proceeds through cleanup. The managed procedures name every closure stop and the named validation-skip rule.
verification: a clean Governed SDD upgrade installs git-workflow v8, task-worktree-boundary v6, and task-worktree-review-procedure v8 while preserving consumer-owned text
Review: REQUIRED remains a REVIEW_REQUIRED gate and delegates post-approval integration to the reviewer-integrator
marker baselines record the bumped capability versions for all managed paths
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
